messages:
incident-bot: Pager — P1: elevated 504/timeouts on /v1/generate across us-west-2 gateways (alert threshold: 5m > 2%). Auto-pager triggered.

sara (oncall): I'm on it. saw the page at 11:22 UTC, spikes across multiple gateways.

miguel (sre): digging in. gateway logs show a lot of upstream timeouts: "upstream timed out (110)" and TCP resets to model-proxy. error rate ~15% for the last 6m. many requests lack spans or request_id.

linh (runtime): model-pool metrics look okay (GPU utilization normal). model-proxy connection resets point to a networking/eject/egress issue or a backend process hitting fd limits.

amanda (product): customer-impact: a handful of Dedicated tenants report failures and retries; preliminary impact: ~8% error for high-volume customers.

sara (oncall): miguel, did any recent deploys touch routing or sampling? I didn't see a formal release.

miguel (sre): no code deploys in the window. config change detected on edge sampling: sampler was effectively 0 for many requests (so traces absent). that explains blind spots.

linh (runtime): proposed stopgap: 1) enable request-id middleware at edge 100% for 15m; 2) set tracing sampler to 100% for gateway namespace for 20m; 3) apply temporary debug log aggregation for gateway and proxy; 4) fast-fail/circuit-breaker on slow proxy connects and route to fallback model.

sara (oncall): ok I'll enable request-id and elevated logging. patching now.

sara (oncall): Command (edge):
```bash
kubectl -n gateway set env ds/edge-nginx EXTRA_DEBUG=1 REQUEST_ID_MODE=always
```

miguel (sre): toggling sampler via opsctl.

miguel (sre): Command (tracing): `opsctl trace set-sampler --namespace=gateway --rate=1.0 --duration=20m`

ops-bot: Runbook executed: trace sampling set to 1.0 for namespace gateway (corr id: 39d2).

amanda (product): can we put a short circuit-breaker rule: if connect latency to model-proxy > 3s then fail-fast and route to fallback model variant? reduces upstream cascading timeouts.

linh (runtime): yes, hotpatch ready. patch snippet: 
```yaml
# hotpatch: fast-fail on connect >3s
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        hotpatch: "fast-fail-3s"
```

sara (oncall): rolling the hotpatch to a 1-node canary now. monitoring.

miguel (sre): after request-id and sampler changes we start seeing traces for previously blind failures. correlating 504s -> backend socket resets. grep for request-id: 
```bash
kubectl logs -n gateway deploy/edge-nginx | jq -r '.msg | select(.contains("request_id"))'
```

linh (runtime): fast-fail patch reduced error rate from ~15% -> ~3% within 2 minutes. still occasional timeouts; cordoning an unhealthy model-proxy host for deeper analysis.

amanda (product): customer outreach note: Tier-B tenants hit degraded throughput; recommend notifications for customers with sustained >5% error over 30m.

sara (oncall): handing to miguel for post-stabilize deep dive. miguel you'll own the follow-up; linch (linh) is backup.

miguel (sre): taking postmortem ownership. I'll keep traces at 100% for 48h and export logs for the triage. creating ticket: PM-INC-1755559999.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next steps: 1) full postmortem within 72h, 2) follow-up on sampling config drift, 3) add a short-lived runbook to enable request-id in similar events, 4) customer outreach as recommended.

sara (oncall): leaving notes in incident doc and switching to monitoring handoff. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
